Use the attached HTML reference as the source of truth. Preserve the visible hierarchy, first-screen composition, section rhythm, density, and interaction tone before adapting copy or content.

Anchor the palette in primary #B7EC4B, secondary #FFFFFF, accent #34C759, background #FFFFFF, surface #8E8E93, text-primary #111827. Keep background, surface, text, and border roles distinct so generated layouts retain the same contrast pattern as the source.

## WebGL & Effects

If the source includes canvas, WebGL, Three.js, gradients, particles, or atmospheric effects, rebuild them as supporting layers behind the content. Keep effects performant, responsive, and secondary to the interface.

- Do not flatten the source into a generic card grid.

- Preserve the first viewport signal, focal object, and visual density.
- Keep buttons, cards, and badges aligned to the same radius and border language.

        :root {

            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
            -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;

        }

        button,

            font: inherit

            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: -.032em;
            color: #0b0b0f;

        .title-large,
        .ios-title {
            font-size: var(--ios-large-title);
            line-height: 1.06;

            font-size: var(--ios-large-title);

        }

        .card-title,

            font-size: var(--ios-title-2);

            font-weight: 650;

        .section-title,

        .search span,

        .stats-row,
        .ios-row-copy strong {
            font-size: var(--ios-subheadline);
            line-height: 20px;
            font-weight: 500;
            letter-spacing: -.014em;
        }

        .chip,
        .soft-chip {
            min-height: 26px;
            height: auto;
            padding: 5px 10px;
            font-size: var(--ios-caption-2);
            line-height: 13px;

            letter-spacing: -.006em;

        }

        .card-sub,
        .doc-sub,
        .micro-label,
        .ios-row-copy span,
        .ios-health-copy span,
        .ios-action-copy span,
        .ios-metric span,
        .ios-kicker,
        .ios-date-pill,
        .ios-row-meta {
            font-size: var(--ios-footnote);

        .ios-section-label {

        .ios-segment span {

        .ios-score-ring span {
